name: drupal-contrib-skills
description: Curated AI agent skills for Drupal Core and Contrib development, issue handling, testing, and patch maintenance.

plugins.name: drupal-core-issue
plugins.description: Resolve and review Drupal Core issues, work with issue forks, run DDEV/PHPUnit tests, and format drupal.org issue comments.

plugins.name: drupal-contrib-issue
plugins.description: Contribute to Drupal contrib modules and themes across both traditional drupal.org issue queues and modern native GitLab issues.

plugins.name: drupal-standards
plugins.description: Enforce Drupal coding standards (PHPCS Drupal/DrupalPractice), PHPStan static analysis, and Drupal architectural patterns.

plugins.name: drupal-patch-reroll
plugins.description: Audit, fix, and reroll Drupal composer patches, discover GitLab MR diffs, and resolve reject files.
